impact.text: ETH sent to Core is stuck forever.

precondition_sources.text: The pool is initialized at tick 0 with liquidity.
The victim submits a swap with a sqrtRatioLimit set near the current price for slippage protection and sends 10 ether as msg.value.

intent_sources.text: When ETH is sent to Core via msg.value during a swap, the pair debt accounting must be updated to account for that ETH, including when the swap is a no-op because sqrtRatio equals sqrtRatioLimit.
A swap that would be a no-op because sqrtRatio equals sqrtRatioLimit must revert when msg.value > 0 rather than silently accepting the ETH.
